p.src: 1  Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

ja: った。イスラエルの兵士たちはペリシテ
en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
u.src: 1  Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

p.src: 2  The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

ja: ヨナタン、アビナダブ、マルキ・シュアを
en: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
u.src: 2  The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

p.src: 3  The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

en: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
u.src: 3  The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

p.src: 4  Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

めないためだ。」しかし、彼の

en: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
u.src: 4  Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

p.src: 5  When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

en: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
u.src: 5  When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

p.src: 6  So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

ja: こうしてサウルとその
en: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
u.src: 6  So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

p.src: 7  When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

ja: にいたすべてのイスラエルの
げ去ったこと、またサウルとその
en: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
u.src: 7  When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

p.src: 8  On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

en: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
u.src: 8  On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

p.src: 9  They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

ja: の至る所に人を遣わして、彼らの偶像と民に知らせを伝えさせた。
en: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
u.src: 9  They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

p.src: 10  They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

en: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

en: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
